At more than 4,000 square millimeters, the M1000 reference platform is a multi-reticle active photonic interposer that enables the world’s largest die complexes in a 3D package, providing connectivity to thousands of GPUs in a single domain. In existing chip designs, interconnects for processors, memory, and I/O chiplets are bandwidth limited because electrical input/output (I/O) connections are restricted to the edges of these chips. The Passage M1000 overcomes this limitation by unleashing electro-optical I/O virtually anywhere on its surface for the die complex stacked on top.
